tokens.name: azure
tokens.usage: Deep Azure, the primary brand ink. The mark and wordmark on light grounds. As text it reads on mist, surface and both tints (9.4:1 or more). White text on an azure fill is 11.4:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Electric Teal, the speed accent. The Swift half of the wordmark on dark, tag fills, code highlights, the chevron motif, section numerals on navy. Never a large fill and never text on a light ground (1.67:1 on mist). Text on a teal fill is on-speed.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Ink Navy. The dark ground: title, section and closing slides, code panels on light slides, the dark theme's page.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Mist, the light ground of slides and pages. The decks use #F5F6F8; the brand guidelines page and the logo pages use #F4F5F7. This system takes the decks' value.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The mark and the 'Kube' half of the wordmark on bg: azure on light, white on dark.

tokens.name: brand-swift
tokens.usage: The 'Swift' half of the wordmark on bg: azure on light, teal on dark.

tokens.name: mark-black
tokens.usage: The mark in a single black ink, for one-colour print. From the logo exploration's solid variant.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and slide background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and panels that sit on bg. Dark value is white at 5% over navy, as the logo exploration's cards draw it.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Large dark bands that must stand apart from the ground in both themes: a title band on a web page, the cover's slab.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Blueprint grid lines behind content slides, 48px pitch at 1920 wide. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on bg, surface, tint-teal and tint-blue (14.3:1 or more light, 12.2:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: sub
tokens.usage: Body copy, node subtitles and slide subtitles on bg, surface and both tints (6.6:1 or more light, 8.0:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and captions on bg and surface (5.6:1 light, 7.1:1 or more dark). The smallest text you may set in grey.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Mono captions on the brand pages. 4.40:1 on mist, below 4.5:1 for small text; 5.2:1 on navy. Kept as the sources draw it; prefer muted for anything a reader needs.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Diagram node borders and connector arrows, 3px at slide scale (12.0:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, row rules, the dashed crosshair on title slides. Decorative only: 1.45:1 light, 1.99:1 dark, so never an input border.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Eyebrows, mono labels, group-frame labels, handwritten annotations, big stat numbers. Reads on bg, surface and both tints in either theme.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in running text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 10.5:1 on mist, 9.9:1 on navy.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: The strong diagram node: the Kubernetes API, the runtime, the thing everything converges on.

tokens.name: on-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Title text inside an accent-fill node (17.8:1 light, 9.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-fill-sub
tokens.usage: Subtitle text inside an accent-fill node (9.9:1 light, 6.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-speed
tokens.usage: Text on a teal fill: filled tags, the 'Swift' highlight chip (9.9:1).

tokens.name: tint-teal
tokens.usage: Fill of nodes KubeSwift owns (controllers, SwiftGuestPool, swiftletd). The slide template also draws #C4F3EE for the same role; this system takes the KCD deck's value.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Fill of nodes KubeSwift does not own: Kubernetes, Flux, external systems.

tokens.name: teal-text
tokens.usage: Proposed, not yet in any deck: teal as text on light grounds (4.61:1 on mist, 4.98:1 on surface). Fails on the tints; use accent there.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code panel fill. On dark slides the panel steps darker than bg.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Code text on code-bg (11.8:1).

tokens.name: code-key
tokens.usage: YAML keys and flags on code-bg (6.8:1).

tokens.name: code-value
tokens.usage: The value the slide is about, on code-bg (9.9:1).

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Line numbers on code-bg. 2.84:1, below 4.5:1: kept as the decks draw it, decorative only.

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of the highlighted code line, with a 4px teal bar on its left edge.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Text of a phase chip for a healthy end state (Running, Ready, Completed, Attached) on status-success-bg: 4.65:1 light, 7.0:1 dark. The console's #1E8E3E darkened to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a success phase chip.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Text of a phase chip for Failed and Error on status-danger-bg: 4.64:1 light, 5.9:1 dark. The console's #D93025 darkened to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a danger phase chip.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Text of a phase chip for waiting or partly healthy states (Pending, Scheduling, Degraded) on status-warning-bg: 4.65:1 light, 7.1:1 dark. The console's #B06000 darkened to pass 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a warning phase chip.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Text of a phase chip for work in progress (Importing, Pulling, Restoring, StopAndCopy) on status-info-bg: 9.4:1 light, 7.3:1 dark. Brand azure replaces the console's Material blue #1A73E8.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of an in-progress phase chip.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Text of a phase chip for inactive states (Stopped, Cancelled, Suspended, unknown) on status-neutral-bg: 6.7:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a neutral phase chip.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Slides
groups.note: Sizes for the 1920 x 1080 slide canvas. In PowerPoint at 13.333 in wide, divide px by 2 for points.

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Title slide headline, two lines at most.

styles.name: slide-numeral
styles.usage: Section divider number, in teal on navy.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.sample: Running VMs, not only booting them
styles.usage: Content slide title, one line, sentence case, no full stop unless it is two sentences.

styles.name: slide-subtitle
styles.sample: A full VM platform with Kubernetes-native fleet operations
styles.usage: One line under the slide title, in sub.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: The Pod launches the hypervisor; the guest keeps its own kernel, disk and lifecycle.

styles.name: slide-node
styles.usage: Title inside a diagram node. 32px for dense diagrams.

styles.name: slide-node-sub
styles.usage: Second line inside a node, in sub.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Section number and label above the slide title, uppercase, in accent.

styles.name: slide-annotation
styles.usage: Handwritten asides on diagrams. Never in UI or docs.

groups.name: Web
groups.note: Sizes from the brand guidelines and logo pages.

styles.name: web-h2
styles.sample: Horizontal and stacked, on light and dark

styles.name: web-body-lg
styles.sample: VMs as first-class CRDs on Cloud Hypervisor.

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: The chevron is a single forward cut on the vertical axis.

styles.name: web-eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels, uppercase. Under the 12px floor; set 12px on new pages.

styles.name: web-caption
styles.usage: Labels under specimens. Under the 12px floor; set 12px on new pages.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags and between icon and text.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its tag; between stacked lines inside a node.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between related items; web card gutters.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between web cards; inner padding of tags at slide scale is 7px by 14px.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between columns of rows on slides.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Web card padding; gap between diagram nodes.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Blueprint grid pitch on slides. Snap node edges to it.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Gap between major slide regions.

tokens.name: slide-pad-top
tokens.usage: Content slide top padding at 1920 x 1080.

tokens.name: slide-pad-x
tokens.usage: Content slide left and right padding; also all sides of title slides.

tokens.name: slide-pad-bottom
tokens.usage: Content slide bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Code highlight band corners, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches at small sizes, favicon frames.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Diagram nodes, tags, dashed group frames. The default.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Colour swatches on brand pages.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Code panels and slide cards.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Web cards on brand pages.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon at 96px.

tokens.name: stroke-node
tokens.usage: Diagram node borders and connectors at slide scale (1.5pt in PowerPoint).

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Column header rules and dashed tags at slide scale.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Row rules and web card borders.

tokens.name: stroke-highlight
tokens.usage: The teal bar on a highlighted code line.

shadow.note: Slides use no shadows. Web cards on brand pages carry these.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Web cards on brand pages.

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile.
